FN-G8ZT6C-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 56
Committee: Education Policy Sponsor: Senator Arthur Orr
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 03/20/2023
Senate Bill 56 as introduced would increase the obligations of local boards of education, by an
undetermined amount, to install, operate, and maintain audio and video recording equipment in
classrooms in which at least half of the students in regular attendance are provided special
education services.
Page 1

FN-G8ZT6C-2
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 56
Committee: Education Policy Sponsor: Senator Arthur Orr
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 03/21/2023
Senate Bill 56 as reported by the Committee on Education Policy could increase the obligations
of local boards of education that install, operate, and maintain audio and video recording
equipment in classrooms in which at least half of the students in regular attendance are provided
special education services. This increased obligation could be offset in whole or in part by any
funding made available from donations to the local boards of education for the purpose of
placing and operating video camera pursuant to this bill.

FN-G8ZT6C-4
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 56
Committee: Education Policy Sponsor: Senator Arthur Orr
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 04/19/2023
Senate Bill 56 as reported by the Committee on Education Policy could increase the obligations
of local boards of education that elect to install, operate, and maintain audio and video recording
equipment in certain special education classrooms. This increased obligation could be offset, in
whole or in part, by any funding from donations to the local boards of education for the purpose
of placing and operating video cameras pursuant to this bill.

FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 56
Committee: Education Policy Sponsor: Senator Arthur Orr
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 04/18/2023
Senate Bill 56 as passed the Senate could increase the obligations of local boards of education
that elect to install, operate, and maintain audio and video recording equipment in certain
special education classrooms. This increased obligation could be offset, in whole or in part, by
any funding from donations to the local boards of education for the purpose of placing and
operating video cameras pursuant to this bill.
